query: Run /blueprint check on the attached release candidate. We do not have an approved architecture baseline yet, but give it a conformance verdict anyway.
expected_behavior: Stops because an approved, versioned architecture baseline is required for a reproducible conformance check
Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT and names the missing approved baseline
Does not infer the intended architecture from the implementation or issue a conforming or non-conforming verdict
Still identifies the concrete artifact that was supplied without pretending it defines the rules
